character_sheet: A small tameable feathered raptor: a 4x7x11 body, a raked neck to a head with a snout and a four-feather crest, two hat pieces, two arms of an upper and a lower piece with three zero-thickness feathers each, two legs of a thigh, a shin, a foot and a toe claw, and a two-piece tail with four zero-thickness feathers (VelocityRaptorModel.java:98-266, 34 parts), drawn at x0.75. 10 HP (20 tamed), speed 0.55 - the fastest thing on legs in the mod - and an attack of 2 it never uses: it has no attack goal (VelocityRaptor.java:60-70, :87-93). It flees monsters within 8 blocks and panics at 1.6 (:65, :67), is tempted by apples and tamed by one in two (:66, :166-182); tamed it follows its owner at 1.5 (:64), is untamed with a dead bush (:193-204), named with a tag (:211-216) and sat with a sneak-click (:220-224). Hurt on a 1-in-20 tick, or one tick in 250, it grazes dandelions, poppies, red tulips, oak leaves or hay within nine blocks, eating the block and healing 2 (:111-160); it takes at most 10 per hit and 2 per fall (:95-109). It spawns in daylight above y 50 (:265-270; ModEntities.java:592-593) and breeds on apples (:255, :272-276). Read it as a sprinting bird-dinosaur: a quick two-legged stride, the crest and tail feathers fluttering - and drooping as it weakens.
size_notes: Drawn at x0.75 of the rig, x0.375 as a baby (VelocityRaptorRenderer.java:24, :39-43; shadow 0.4125, :26) on a 128x128 sheet (VelocityRaptorModel.java:268), velocityraptor.png (VelocityRaptorRenderer.java:20); the hitbox is 0.5 x 0.6 (ModEntities.java:592-593). The original's ModelVelocityRaptor(1.25f) argument was the wingspeed (VelocityRaptorModel.java:21), not a scale. The crest and tail feathers scale their rate and size by the health fraction (:284-288, :306).

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.25 = 0.785 rad (45 deg) x the walking speed above a limbSwingAmount of 0.1, every piece of a leg by the same angle about its rest (thigh 0, shin 0.488, foot 0, claw 0.628), the right leg the negative; 0 below the threshold
groups.plain: the two legs stride fore and aft as stiff chains, opposite each other
groups.math: a = amount > 0.1 ? cos(t * 1.3 * 1.25) * pi * 0.25 * amount : 0; bl1.xRot = a; bl2.xRot = a + 0.488; bl3.xRot = a; bl4.xRot = a + 0.628; br1..4 = -a + the same rests
groups.phase: the limbSwingAmount threshold of 0.1 gates it
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x 1.25 = 1.625: the natural period is 3.87 ticks

groups.name: crest
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.1 = 0.314 rad (18 deg) x the health fraction at 1.25 x 1.25 x the health fraction rad/tick, feathers 1 and 3 one way, 2 and 4 the other - at full health an 18-degree flutter every 4 ticks, dwindling to nothing as it dies
groups.plain: the four crest feathers flutter side to side in alternation, fast and wide when healthy, slow and limp when hurt
groups.math: hf = health / maxHealth; c = cos(t * 1.25 * 1.25 * hf) * pi * 0.1 * hf; hf1.yRot = hf3.yRot = c; hf2.yRot = hf4.yRot = -c
groups.phase: the health fraction (client-known) scales both rate and size
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.25 x 1.25 x hf: 4.02 ticks at full health, longer as the health drops

groups.name: arms
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.05 = 0.157 rad (9 deg) about each piece's rest (upper 0.279, lower -0.436, feathers -0.279 / -0.453 / -1.047), the right arm the negative
groups.plain: the two arms and their feathers sway slowly fore and aft in opposition at all times
groups.math: a = cos(t * 0.3) * pi * 0.05; lf1.xRot = a + 0.279; lf2.xRot = a - 0.436; lff1.xRot = a - 0.279; lff2.xRot = a - 0.453; lff3.xRot = a - 1.047; the right arm: -a + the same rests
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.3 (no wingspeed term): the natural period is 20.9 ticks

groups.name: arm_feathers
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.1 = 0.314 rad (18 deg), feathers 1 and 3 of the left arm one way and feather 2 the other, the right arm mirrored
groups.plain: the six arm feathers flutter in alternation at the stride's rate at all times, over the arms' slow sway
groups.math: f = cos(t * 1.3 * 1.25) * pi * 0.1; lff1.yRot = lff3.yRot = f; lff2.yRot = -f; rff1.yRot = rff3.yRot = -f; rff2.yRot = f
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x 1.25 = 1.625: the natural period is 3.87 ticks, the gait's rate but unscaled by the walk

groups.name: tail_feathers
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.25 = 0.785 rad (45 deg) x the health fraction at 1.4 x 1.25 x the health fraction rad/tick, feathers 1 and 3 one way, 2 and 4 the other; 0 (flat) in the sitting pose
groups.plain: the four tail feathers roll in alternation, wide and fast when healthy, limp when hurt, flat when sitting
groups.math: r = sitting ? 0 : cos(t * 1.4 * 1.25 * hf) * pi * 0.25 * hf; tf1.zRot = tf3.zRot = r; tf2.zRot = tf4.zRot = -r
groups.phase: isInSittingPose (the sneak-click, VelocityRaptor.java:220-224) zeroes it; the health fraction scales rate and size
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.4 x 1.25 x hf: 3.59 ticks at full health

behaviour: One gait rhythm above a limbSwingAmount of 0.1 (VelocityRaptorModel.java:275-283): the two legs stride 45 degrees x the walking speed as stiff chains in opposition at 1.625 rad/tick, a 3.9-tick period - a sprint at the 0.55 speed (VelocityRaptor.java:91).

Four unscaled rhythms: the arms sway 9 degrees in opposition on a 21-tick cosine (:289-299); the six arm feathers flutter 18 degrees in alternation at the stride's rate whether or not it walks (:300-305); the crest feathers flutter 18 degrees at 1.56 rad/tick and the tail feathers roll 45 degrees at 1.75 rad/tick in alternation - both scaled in rate and size by the health fraction, so a wounded raptor's feathers go slow and limp (:284-288, :306-310); the sitting pose flattens the tail feathers (:306).

The body, neck, head, snout, hats and the two tail pieces are static; the head does not follow the look. The graze (VelocityRaptor.java:142-159) and the sit toggle (:220-224) draw no pose beyond the flat tail feathers.
